name: Group Post
strategic_objective: Peer-to-peer interaction, community support, and topic-focused discussion inside a group.

tone: Peer-level, conversational, and inclusive. Less brand-broadcast, more member-to-member dialogue.
copywriting_rules: Write as if speaking directly to fellow members. Use questions, prompts, and scenarios to trigger replies. Avoid one-way announcements; aim for back-and-forth discussion.
Line 1: clear question, statement, or scenario. Lines 2–3: minimal context or explanation. Final line: direct question or prompt for input.
Use only if the group culture uses specific tags for topics or threads.
Tag members or admins when their input is particularly relevant, but avoid over-tagging.

hard_constraints: Brand-style announcements with no invitation to engage
Off-topic posts unrelated to the group’s purpose
